flaws: monolingual: only one language variant on disk; lifting_plan: add second variant when needed
lacking: tool_create_card does not yet write version archives (lifting_plan: add to create_card's commit step)
name: card_versioning
rationale: Without versioning, edits lose history and rollback is impossible. The protocol is documented here; full enforcement is in tool_create_card after E2 implementation lands.
statement: Versioning protocol for card.json edits. Every card may carry metadata.version (semver) and metadata.previous_content_hash. tool_create_card writes the prior version to cards/version/<name>/<v>/ before overwriting.
